paragraphs: R' Zekharyah ben Avkulas, at the time of the Destruction. See Gittin 56a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: An isolated כ precedes Gittin in the frozen text.

Zekharyah’s title is abbreviated and retained as R'. The source’s Destruction-era description remains without an independently bound chronology or identity. The isolated כ is rendered as the inherited See-type marker without asserting a particular expansion;56a follows the period convention and remains unverified against a named edition.
